svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 98 x 52 x 3.5 mm with a 42 x 42 window for the Peltier module.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 3.5 mm holes 26 up from the bottom edge: two at 24.5 each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (module clamp screws pass) and two at 44 each side (frame screws).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drip tray along the bottom edge: floor 68 x 13.5 x 2 mm with 2 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lips at both ends, reaching back to the shell.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drain hole 5 mm, 3.5 mm from the shell end, 30 toward the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The plate is thinner than the module (4 mm), so the clamp force goes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through the module, not the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: plate on the block's front rim; M3 screws into the shell towers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 0.5 mm gap between the plate and the heat sink.
